name: Kyougoku Tenshou
source:
A senpai who lives at Mijin-so and is Sera’s childhood friend.

A handsome guy who attracts a lot of attention from girls, but he isn’t very bright about that.
Tenshou works hard every day to become a cool senior, but his efforts often backfire.
He learned his special skill (baking bread) from "Fueko-san", the innkeeper.
